ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the graph of the linear function $y=kx+b$ (where $k$ and $b$ are constants) is depicted as illustrated. What is the solution set of the inequality $kx+b<1$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: \textbf{Solution:} From the graph, we know that the linear function $y=kx+b$ ($k,b$ are constants, $k\neq 0$) passes through the point $(0,1)$, and the value of $y$ increases as $x$ increases. Therefore, the solution set of the inequality $kx+b<1$ is $\boxed{x<0}$.
